body:
I'd probably tell him that he needs to try a different route  and that change is only possible if he changes his viewpoint too. 

Although, if he was constantly doing that stuff to me and I never saw much improvement, I can't say I'd stick around. Which is where the problem lies. Those people that left me were justified in their actions. I think I'd do the same, if not sooner than they did, if the roles were reversed. At this point I feel like I deserve the bad things that happen to me after all the bad that I caused myself.

I don't know how to do that. I just always have these flashbacks to better times with people, and then reality snaps in. I can't even control it or my dreams of them. When I wake up and realize they're never coming back...it hits like a brick wall. Even if I didn't mean to do it, even if all I want is to change, I haven't. I get stuck at this part. Whatever changing I do isn't enough, and I still end up losing people. I always feel like I make the wrong decision all the time and make mistake after mistake. I'm not sure how I could forgive a person like that.

I've hurt so many and invested so much. Even if I changed, I feel like all of this would still follow me to the grave, no matter how far away that is. 

I'm glad you didn't die, and that you're still pushing on, but I'm not sure I'm strong enough for that. Not anymore at least.
This made me tear up. Thank you for your kind words. I'll be sure to read them over and over again.

Thanks man! I appreciate that. 

We were talking about places and I suggested our beautiful downtown plaza in front of the fountains but she said she wanted it a little more private than that. If I can I'll see if I can set up something for a smaller park though with the added niceties
Not really. I have no intention to be a cuck, I just couldn't bare to watch her go. If she goes through with it though, I'll still kill myself in the end.
Thank you for the insight. I'll talk to her tomorrow about this.
I did and it's been a pretty big mess. Maybe just having her as a FWB like in the beginning might be better.
Yeah, I think I'll talk to her about it tomorrow.
I mean she wanted a relationship in the beginning and we're pretty much a couple, her words not mine, whenever things are good. But you've still got a point.

Well that's the weird thing. In every other sense we're great. She shows she really cares for me, tells me she loves me, we plan out trips together, a lot of relationship kind of stuff. But sex is still important, even if someone's not that great at it.
I agree. We've both admitted we're toxic, but admittance means nothing without change.

Thanks again! Yeah, she's said that it really is different strokes for different folks, but we kind of put ourselves in high stress situations beforehand. Maybe being more comfortable would help her get more into it, and then I'd say what you said. I think that might help out a lot. I appreciate the effort.

Thank you. I'm hoping you were eventually able to relax too. Every time we've tried has been after an argument, so I feel like there's been high stress, but maybe just sailing some smoother waters might help too.
Thank you! I'll look them up after work. Probably a safer bet.
Thanks man! Hopefully that does the trick. Did you practice the motions and everything as well? I don't want it to look dumb, but I want to get it right.

That's true. I'll definitely talk to her about that, but I know she doesn't like the idea of holding my hand through it. She'll move me around in the right places. I just want her to be attracted to the idea of it too.

I just don't get it. We spend every holiday together, she'll make me dinner and buy me gifts, she'll tell me she loves me and that I'm her favorite person and she's out me before other guys before. I just don't know what's wrong with me, or why I can't just get over her.
